sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Production and Global Distribution of Vertical Micro-Dramas

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state commercial registry distinction)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1-51; supplementary application of Código de Comercio Articles 110-116 and 373, and Law 1780 of 2016 (SAS simplified registration)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del lugar del domicilio principal (Bogotá Chamber of Commerce), acting through the Registro Único Empresarial — RUES
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) filed with the Chamber of Commerce and inscribed in the Registro Único Empresarial
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum capital; the incorporation instrument must state the subscribed and paid-in capital, which may be zero (sólo capital diferido). SAS rules allow a 2-year maximum term for deferred capital contributions; no escrow account is required under the Companies Act unless the bylaws or a shareholders’ agreement so provide.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION. The undersigned founder-shareholders of [COMPANY NAME], SAS, having subscribed all shares of the authorized capital in Documento Privado de Constitución dated [DATE], hereby resolve: (1) the share subscription and capital contributions described in the incorporation instrument are ratified and issued as fully binding; (2) the registered office is initially established at [ADDRESS], municipality of [CITY], Colombia; (3) [NAME] is appointed as Legal Representative (Representante Legal), [NAME] as Secretary, and [NAME] as Compliance Officer, each with the powers conferred by Law 1258 and the bylaws; and (4) the officers are authorized to open corporate bank accounts and commence regulatory registrations. In witness whereof, this resolution is executed and recorded in the Company’s official book.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) — RUES online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search request through the online RUES platform or at the Chamber’s service window. Provide two alternative trade names. The Chamber issues a Certificate of Homonymy (Certificado de Homonimia) confirming the name is distinctive and not confusingly similar to an existing registered trademark or company name. No payment is required at this step unless the name is reserved.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected or deemed similar, submit a formal objection with arguments of distinctiveness or choose an alternative name; the Chamber re-evaluates within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft Preparation and Execution of Bylaws and Private Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary and Attesting Parties (Legal Representative or registered agents)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución setting forth the bylaws, scope of activities (including production and global distribution of vertical micro-dramas under ISIC 5911), capital structure, share classes, officer appointment rules, and the legal representative’s powers. The document must be signed by all founding shareholders, with acknowledgment of signatures before a notary not required for SAS unless the transaction involves real estate or special legal formalities.
required_dossiers: List of shareholders with passport or national ID number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber rejects the document for missing clauses, correct and re-execute the private instrument; the representative signs a supplementary rectification document, which is then filed electronically.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with Chamber of Commerce and RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (or local chamber) — RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Documento Privado de Constitución and the Certificate of Homonymy through the RUES online filing system or with pre-notarized forms. Pay the registration fee calculated on a sliding scale based on the subscribed capital. Upon registration, the Chamber returns a Matrícula Mercantil (commercial registration certificate) and the RUES accession, which constitutes formal legal existence.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registration fee
Lease agreement or utility bill evidencing the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is suspended or queried, respond to the Chamber’s observations within 10 business days by submitting corrected forms; any defect in the b-generalities or signature pages is cured by a rectification document.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Identification Registration (RUT) and DIAN Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RUES registration, the system automatically transmits the registration data to DIAN; obtain the temporary RUT (Registro Único Tributario) showing the company’s NIT and applicable tax regime (e.g., standard, simplified or predominant). Activate the e-invoicing electronic billing mechanism by submitting the RUT, obtain an e-signature certificate, and register the company as an issuer of electronic invoices within 30 days if required.
required_dossiers: Due diligence on the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT application for inconsistencies, correct the data on the RUES portal and re-request the RUT. If the e-invoicing certificate remains pending, file an appeal via the DIAN electronic assistance portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Opening, Zoning, and Municipal Operational Permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Mayor’s Office of the municipality — Planeación Distrital (urban planning) and local revenue authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with the municipal cadastre for industry and commerce tax (ICA) if the company will operate from premises. Obtain a zoning and operating permit (Certificado de Uso de Suelo or Uso de Suelo compatible) confirming that the registered office can host production or administrative activities. If the activity involves a physical studio or office, request a building occupancy certificate (Certificado de Seguridad y Convivencia) and an occupancy license (Licencia de Ocupación) where applicable.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the zoning approval is unfavorable, apply for a special administrative use variance (uso múltiple) or relocate to a permissible zone; any rejection triggers a 10-day correction period to resubmit with additional evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Books, Bank Account, and Post-Incorporation Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio and commercial banks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account in a Colombian bank with the certified bylaws, NIT-RUT, and Board Resolution appointing the legal representative. Purchase and register the official corporate books (libro de actas, libro de accionistas, and the statutory register of contributors) from the Chamber of Commerce. Banks may require a Board Resolution confirming the bank signatories.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account application for incomplete documentation, obtain a certificate of account opening refusal and re-apply with the corrected dossiers. For the corporate books, request re-issuance from the Chamber if the registration is delayed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Culture — Audiovisual, Cinema and Interactive Media Direction (criterion: optional sectoral registration) and the municipal Urban Planning and Civil Defense Office
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial Operating license must be based on municipal zoning permit (Certificado de Uso de Suelo) and a temporary or permanent authorization for filming if a physical audiovisual production set is used; a statutory state production license is not required for vertical micro-drama production under ISIC 5911

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible (National Environmental Licensing Authority — ANLA for national-level projects; local CAR for municipal activities)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Low Impact — normally excluded from a full EIA for digital content production and streaming activities; a Protocol of Simple Environmental Filing (PMA) may be required only if physical set construction, temporary waste disposal, or a data center with high energy consumption is developed
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For any physical production facility, wastewater discharges must comply with Resolution 0631 of 2015 (maximum pH 6-9, COD 150 mg/L, TSS 50 mg/L); volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in studios must remain below Colombian occupational limit (Resolution 2400 of 1979 and ACGIH thresholds); hazardous waste and e-waste must be handled under Resolution 1512 of 2010 and Law 1252 of 2008.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (National Tax and Customs Directorate). Portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional e-services: MUISCA platform (muisca.dian.gov.co); mobile RUT enrollment via the DIAN app; foreign trade declarations via VUCE/DIAN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: All taxpayers, including 100% foreign-owned Colombian S.A.S., must obtain the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) by enrolling in the RUT (Registro Único Tributario). Procedure: (1) Incorporate the S.A.S. by private document registered with the Cámara de Comercio of the registered office; foreign shareholders need no Colombian residence, but a local legal representative (representante legal) must be appointed. (2) File RUT registration online through the DIAN RUT en línea module or an authorized gestor, submitting the certificate of existence and legal representation, apostilled and officially translated corporate documents of any foreign corporate shareholder, and the representative's identity documentation. (3) DIAN validates in real time and assigns the NIT with the applicable responsibility codes for income tax (renta), VAT (IVA), and withholding agent (agente de retención). (4) Obtain a DIAN-authorized digital signature certificate for electronic invoicing. (5) Register the invoicing software (software propio or proveedor tecnológico) with DIAN. RUT issuance is typically completed within 1 to 5 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable for check-the-box: Colombia has no pass-through or US-style entity classification election; an S.A.S. is by law a taxable resident corporation subject to 35% corporate income tax on worldwide income (2024 and 2025 rates), with a foreign tax credit for foreign-source income taxes. Relevant statutory elections available: (1) opt for the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) for qualifying micro/small merchants with gross ordinary income up to approximately 100,000 UVT (inflation-indexed), which replaces income tax, VAT and municipal industry/commerce tax on a single return; (2) choose bimonthly (rather than annual) VAT refund filing as an exporter; (3) apply for the ProColombia Certificado de Exportación de Servicios to document service exports; (4) elect standard accelerated depreciation methods within DIAN limits; (5) hybrid mismatch limitation rules of Law 1819/2016 are mandatory disallowances, not elective reliefs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto al Valor Agregado (Value Added Tax).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 4,195,200,000 (95,000 UVT for 2024; UVT = COP 44,160, annually indexed) is the small-merchant exemption from VAT liability. Below this threshold a merchant of goods is not a VAT responsable; however, registration in the RUT and VAT compliance are mandatory from the first peso for all providers of taxable digital services, streaming, software and export services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta - FE) with DIAN prior validation (validación previa) applies to all VAT-responsible taxpayers, including the S.A.S. operating a short-drama streaming app. Each FE must be produced exclusively in DIAN-certified software (own software approved by DIAN or via a registered proveedor tecnológico), signed with an authorized digital certificate, and transmitted synchronously to DIAN MUISCA web services (SOAP/XML API with REST capabilities) for acceptance or rejection before delivery to the buyer. The graphical representation must include the 96-character CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and a QR code. Export invoices for services use the special FE export modality. Credit/debit notes, payroll notes, and the Documento Soporte en Adquisiciones must be filed as events to DIAN.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports are VAT-excluded (functionally 0%) with entitlement to recovery of input VAT (saldo a favor). The Colombian S.A.S. may zero-rate: (1) digital services (streaming, downloadable content, software and content licensing) rendered to recipients domiciled outside Colombia and used exclusively abroad, where payment originates from foreign app stores, gateways or banks and the recipient is not a Colombian tax resident; (2) expressly, digital services acquired over the internet by non-residents are deemed exportación de servicios under Article 481 E.T. as amended; (3) physical exports of goods (e.g. marketing merchandise) with a DEX; (4) ancillary production and localization services rendered to a non-resident counterparty and used abroad. Conditions: a valid contract, FE export-modality invoice, actual remittance from abroad, and no Colombian-source use or onshore beneficiary. Input VAT on local production, crew, rent, advertising and logistics becomes refundable; transfer-pricing and permanent-establishment rules must not recharacterize the outbound service as domestic-source.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX via MUISCA) - mandatory only for physical goods; for pure digital service exports, the FE export-modality e-invoice serves as the export declaration equivalent
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill - required only for physical shipments; not applicable to digital streaming service exports

Inward remittance certificate / Declaración de Cambio - FX channeling certificate issued by the Colombian authorized intermediary evidencing foreign currency proceeds entering Colombia's exchange market
ProColombia Certificado de Exportación de Servicios - optional but strongly recommended to support zero-rating and VAT refund substantiation
Signed distribution, license and revenue-share agreement with the non-resident platform (Apple, Google or other OTTS)
App-store payout statements (Apple and Google financial reports) reconciled to subscription revenue and bank receipts
Non-residence evidence: recipient billing country, IP/device location logs, and app-store country store codes
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims and VAT refunds are high-priority DIAN audit targets. DIAN may require a bank guarantee to secure a refund and cross-checks the FE event records, FX channeling, and the recipient's foreign tax residence. Refund rejection or revocation triggers: (i) a 20% penalty on the improperly refunded amount (Article 670 E.T.); (ii) retroactive default interest on the refunded sum at the certificado de depósito rate plus tax (Article 635 E.T.); (iii) correction surcharges and the inexacta penalty up to 160% of the higher tax in the corrected return (Article 647 E.T.); (iv) foreign-exchange fines up to 200% of the value not channeled within the 180-day deadline (Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 of Banco de la República); and (v) criminal tax evasion under Law 2010 of 2019, carrying 48 to 108 months of imprisonment and disqualification from contracting with the State where fraudulent concealment or falsified documents are used to obtain undue refunds. Clawback is retroactive to the refund payment date and may be asserted against both the entity and its legal representative in cases of serious fault. The DIAN audit window is generally 5 years from filing.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia, acting with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia and the Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero (UIAF) on AML supervision; the operative framework is Resolución Externa No. 1 de 2018 of the Junta Directiva del Banco de la República, as amended, together with Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-245 and Circular Básica Jurídica 029 de 2014 of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (municipal Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly surcharge of 1.5% of the renewal tariff for each month of delay; repeated non-renewal triggers administrative cancellation of the mercantile registry and loss of standing to engage in commercial activity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementario)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between April and August immediately following the fiscal year end, according to the NIT last-digit schedule published annually by DIAN
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 0.5% of assessed tax per month or fraction thereof, with a total cap of 50% of tax owed; failure-to-file and non-payment sanctions include fines up to 15,000 UVT and possible administrative collection proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and Filing of Audited Financial Statements with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social; copies sent to DIAN for entities subject to supervision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements must be approved by the shareholders' meeting no later than March 31 of the following year and registered within 30 days of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to register financial statements may result in late registration surcharges and prevents the renewal of the mercantile registry; administrative penalties may be imposed under the Código de Comercio.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner Report (Información de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, within the term indicated by DIAN Resolution, typically between May and June for the previous fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance may result in a fine of up to 0.2% of the taxpayer's gross income or assets, up to a maximum of 36,000 UVT; repeated non-compliance may lead to injunction and suspension of tax registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, generally during May and June, based on the DIAN calendar for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Articles 651 and 652 of the Estatuto Tributario of up to 30,000 UVT for failure to submit, incorrect submissions, or late submissions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) is required for a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada when total assets exceed 5,000 minimum legal monthly wages (SMLMV) or gross income in the prior fiscal year exceeds 3,000 SMLMV; special regimes also apply to public-interest entities and entities holding significant public funding.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by Colombia, or NIIF para las Pymes (IFRS for SMEs) for small and medium entities based on the classification set by the Consejo Técnico de la Contaduría Pública.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: S.A.S. entities must maintain a current register of ultimate beneficial owners and submit an annual confirmation to DIAN updating shareholding structures, transfers of shares, and other material changes in direct or indirect ownership of 5% or more, in accordance with Resolution 164 of 2021.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registro de Junta Directiva, if constituted)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Register of Share Certificates (Libro de Registro de Certificados de Acción)
Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (general corporate income rate for FY2024 and FY2025; single national CIT rate after CREE integration).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic sectoral holiday for a micro-drama production/distribution S.A.S. Preferential treatment is limited to certified activities: 165% deduction for qualifying research, technology and innovation investments under Article 158-1 E.T.; possible 10-year renta exenta only for formally certified film/audiovisual projects under special regimes; ordinary streaming and subscription revenue remains taxable at 35% absent a certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios for legal entities) filed through DIAN's electronic portal 'MUISCA' / DIAN Sede Electrónica.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Deadline falls in April-May of the following year based on the last two digits of the NIT. For FY2024 returns, DIAN set the window from 9 April to 21 May 2025; no extension except by DIAN decree.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT del declarante - taxpayer identification number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not use their home ID; the Colombian S.A.S. must have a valid NIT before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ejercicio gravable - taxable year being declared.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the calendar year; no consolidated non-resident group relief.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Código actividad económica (CIIU) - primary industry classification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use ISS/CIIU code corresponding to 5911 for micro-drama production and distribution, plus any app-distribution code; describe actual commercial activity consistently with Stripe/App Store reporting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos brutos operacionales y no operacionales - gross receipts from subscription, in-app purchases, advertising and content distribution.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All receipts sourced to Colombia, including Apple IAP and Google Play Billing remittances, must be declared at gross amounts before platform commissions; separately record non-deductible withholdings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costos y deducciones - production costs, licensing fees, royalties, platform commissions, fixed asset depreciation/amortization.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border payments to related parties require OECD-compliant TP and documentary support; non-deductible payments without economic substance must be added back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Renta líquida ordinaria and compensación de pérdidas - taxable net income after loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Colombian S.A.S. computes this after applying Colombian loss offset; non-resident owners cannot use their foreign losses in Colombia.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impuesto de renta a cargo - corporate income tax at 35% on taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the corporate-level tax and is the base for later dividend withholding on distributions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Anticipos, retenciones y autorretenciones - prepayments, withholding credits and payments already made.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the Colombian entity's own prepayments are creditable; amounts withheld from payments to non-residents are not a credit of the S.A.S. unless the company legally bears the tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a 5% extemporaneity penalty on the tax shown due, subject to a minimum 10 UVT (approx. COP 470,650 for 2024, UVT=47,065), increasing if DIAN issues an official requirement; moratory interest accrues daily; late payment without filing is a separate default. For a zero-tax return, DIAN may apply a penalty based on gross income/net worth under Article 641 E.T.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% (on dividends distributed from profits already taxed at the 35% corporate rate).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Withholding must be applied by the Colombian payer at distribution. To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident parent must prove tax residence in the treaty country by submitting a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign competent authority, with official Spanish translation/apostille, to the Colombian withholding agent before the beneficial-owner test is passed. The agent then accepts the treaty-reduced rate, or the recipient files a refund claim with DIAN through 'Devoluciones y Compensaciones' after showing DTA application. Colombia has no comprehensive DTA with the United States.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: 33% on royalties/license fees for use of IP, 15% on interest and financing yields, and 15% on technical or management services. Treaty rates may be lower if a DTA applies and the TRC and economic substance of the recipient are documented; payments to tax-haven/zero-tax jurisdictions are treated as repatriated dividends without such proof.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File and annual TP filing obligations arise for the S.A.S. if gross income or gross assets exceed 45,000 UVT (approx. COP 2,117,925,000 for FY2024), or if aggregate transactions with foreign related parties exceed 10,000 UVT (approx. COP 470,650,000); a Master File is required for multinational groups with consolidated revenue above 250,000 UVT. A micro-drama S.A.S. should nevertheless prepare contemporaneous TP analysis if any cross-border related-party services or IP royalties are paid.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulation, but DIAN enforces substance-over-form under Article 28 E.T., the general anti-avoidance rule (Article 869-2 E.T.), and the beneficial-owner requirement in DTAs. For a micro-drama platform, actual human operations, local IP development, board control and management decisions must be in Colombia; a sham S.A.S. or purely passive conduit with no local substance will be disregarded and its payments recharacterized.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Omission of Colombian-Source Income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Treating App Store/Google Play and Stripe subscription proceeds as foreign income, maintaining two sets of revenue ledgers, under-reporting royalties from global micro-drama distribution, or issuing bogus platform-fee invoices to reduce taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN can assess the omitted tax plus an increased-return penalty of up to 200% of the understated liability, apply moratory interest, and impose criminal fines; tax evasion has statutory penalties of up to 9 years' imprisonment under Colombian criminal tax law when fraudulent intent is shown.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil protects shareholders only if the S.A.S. is validly constituted and administered. Administrators who knowingly sign fraudulent returns or retain funds knowing there is no capacity to pay tax are jointly liable for unpaid tax, subject to embargo of personal assets, travel bans, and disqualification from managing Colombian companies upon criminal conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing and Unreported Related-Party Transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying a foreign parent or offshore IP owner inflated royalties for the micro-drama catalog, failing to file Form 120 and Local/Master File documentation, engaging in back-to-back licensing without personnel or functions, or using a zero-tax holding company as the app content owner without arm's-length compensation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may recharacterize the transaction, disallow the deduction, assess 35% CIT on the adjustment together with interest, and impose a TP penalty of 100% of the understated tax or 4% of the transaction value if required documentation is not delivered; in serious cases, criminal evasion penalties apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve TP documentation known to be false can be held personally liable for resulting tax deficiencies and disgorgement of benefits. Foreign directors are not immune; DIAN may issue joint liability notices and coordinate with overseas authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Disguised Profit Repatriation and Dividend Withholding Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Characterizing a dividend distribution as a reimbursable shareholder loan, management fee or service charge to avoid the 10% dividend WHT; accumulating profits in the S.A.S. without distribution for the purpose of avoiding Colombian source tax; or paying excessive board fees to non-resident owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The full amount is reclassified as non-deductible and taxable as a distribution; the negligent payer must remit the 10% dividend WHT, plus penalties of 100% of the withheld amount for failure to withhold, moratory interest, and possible criminal liability for breach of withholding duties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Colombian company law requires administrators to ensure withholding and tax obligations are fulfilled. Failure to retain and pay dividend WHT makes the current administrator personally liable for the unremitted withholding, and a director may face economic embargo while the shareholders remain liable for corporate tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using shell cashout entities to disguise Apple/IAP and Google/Stripe payouts, structuring large amounts into 'production fees' to avoid transaction controls, failing to conduct CDD/EDD on content-production counterparties, or accepting funds from sanctioned jurisdictions for micro-drama distribution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Colombia's UIAF and financial/administrative regulators can impose fines in UVT and freeze assets; money-laundering convictions carry 10-30 years' imprisonment. Deficient AML programs expose the S.A.S. to regulatory revocation of authorizations, reputational downgrade, and seizure of bank accounts used by payment aggregators.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Compliance officers and legal representatives who knowingly execute or omit AML controls face personal criminal liability, patrimonial forfeiture of illicit gains, and travel restrictions during investigation; non-resident beneficial owners cannot shield themselves by using nominee directors in the S.A.S.
